description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for the 'Free Checkout' payment extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods to display the settings page and save configuration data related to the free checkout payment method.

classes.name: FreeCheckout
classes.description: Controller class for managing Free Checkout payment settings in the OpenCart admin interface.
